exact_statement: For all integers r,s>=4, on the physical sign Boolean two-intersecting-core private-pair family f=2 product_X OR(z0,z1,X_j1,X_j2) product_Y OR(z1,z2,Y_j1,Y_j2)-1, the fixed actual anchor/local-uniform-mask UNION source with each X activation1/(2r) and each Y activation1/(2s) is globally incidence feasible and has complete nonempty spectral cross entropy C_Q/I<1429/60<24. In contrast, the source with equal activation1/(r+s) on all clauses satisfies C_equal/I>(1/162)log2[225(r+s)^2/(2rs)], unbounded at s=4,r tending to infinity; the same lower bound holds after mixing this fixed source with any distributions supported inside individual cores. Full anchor/allocation posteriors are included. Thus the equal-weight fixed-source class fails but the feasible-weight variational infimum is bounded on this family.

Lower-bound mixtures fix the equal-activation source; every other branch is supported on nonempty subsets of {z0,z1} or {z1,z2}. Arbitrary activation retuning is excluded from this lower-bound class.

With M=v the candidate is globally optimal. On the fixed fifteen-run maximal-matching star subreference for the K3 edge-union function, all incidence-feasible positive weights and all fixed mixtures have exact infimum (3/4)log2(217/16)+(1/4)log2(651), attained at lambda=(1/2,1/2,1/2); the earned posterior entropy is3/4+(1/4)log2(6). The physically infeasible used-root-simplex relaxation has gap121/96 natural units at that same candidate, whereas this certificate has zero gap. The claim does not lower-bound references with additional omitted runs and does not provide universal influence payment.
